title: Undergraduate Academic Calendar 2026/2027
text:
Application Deadlines & Types
The university reserves the right to close admission to any
program
once the application deadline passes. Applicants are advised to apply and submit the required documentation as soon as possible.
Laurier's primary entry
term
is fall. Programs may open for winter or spring admission at the discretion of the university. If programs open for winter or spring admission, program availability, application instructions and admission deadlines will be made available in the Admissions Toolkit prior to the entry term
All applicants to Laurier must using one of the following applications:
The Ontario Universities Application Centre (OUAC) undergraduate application for all full-time and part-time programs.
Applicants only interested in applying to Laurier for part-time studies can use the Part-time application found on Lauriers website.
International applicants interested in applying to Laurier for the winter term can use the Winter application found on Lauriers website.
